R Package for getting spatial data from Berlin Geoportal
(<https://gdi.berlin.de/geonetwork/srv/ger/catalog.search#/search>)) .

## Installation

For details on how to install KWB-R packages checkout our [installation
tutorial](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.pkgbuild/articles/install.html).

``` r

### Optionally: specify GitHub Personal Access Token (GITHUB_PAT)
### See here why this might be important for you:
### https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.pkgbuild/articles/install.html#set-your-github_pat

# Sys.setenv(GITHUB_PAT = "mysecret_access_token")

# Install package "remotes" from CRAN
if (! require("remotes")) {
  install.packages("remotes", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

# Install KWB package 'kwb.geoportal' from GitHub
remotes::install_github("KWB-R/kwb.geoportal")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`find_wfs()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/find_wfs.md)
  : Find WFS services in the Geoportal catalogue
- [`list_wfs_layers()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/list_wfs_layers.md)
  : List the feature types offered by a WFS service
- [`parse_gn_link()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/parse_gn_link.md)
  : Parse a single GeoNetwork link element
- [`read_metadata()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/read_metadata.md)
  : Read GeoNetwork service metadata (one row per service)
- [`read_metadata_all()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/read_metadata_all.md)
  : Read all GeoNetwork / Geoportal metadata in chunks
- [`read_wfs()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/read_wfs.md)
  : Read a WFS layer from the Berlin Geoportal
- [`read_wfs_sf_auto()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/read_wfs_sf_auto.md)
  : Read a WFS layer (auto-detect from URL)
- [`wfs_base_url()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/wfs_base_url.md)
  : Base URL of a Berlin Geoportal WFS service
- [`wfs_service_name()`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.geoportal/reference/wfs_service_name.md)
  : Service name of a WFS endpoint URL
